name: Naomi ~Bishoujo-tachi no Yakata~
original_name: 奈緒美　～美少女たちの館～
source:
Naomi has entered a forbidden place, The House of Beautiful Women. What happens to innocent girls there? Come on and open the door! You control their fate!

[translated from [url=http://fandc.co.jp/catalog/pc/44]fandc.co.jp[/url]]
